title: Theme via CSS variables, not hardcoded colors
guideline: Use the generated CSS variable tokens (--primary, --background) so theming/dark-mode stays consistent

title: Compose shadcn primitives rather than rebuilding them
guideline: Build higher-level components by composing existing primitives (Dialog, Popover, Command) instead of reinventing them

title: Pair Form components with react-hook-form + zod
guideline: Use the shadcn Form wrapper with a zod schema for typed, accessible validation

title: Define component variants with cva
guideline: Use class-variance-authority for variant/size props instead of ad-hoc conditional className strings

title: Rely on Radix primitives for accessible behavior
guideline: Don't strip away the built-in keyboard/focus handling that Radix-based primitives provide

title: Use next-themes (or equivalent) for theme switching
guideline: Drive the dark-mode class toggle through a dedicated theme provider, not manual class manipulation
